faqs.a:
(a)
In addition to persons called by the parties to testify, the hearing officer may,
               in his discretion and in view of the purpose of the hearing, permit other interested
               persons to testify.
(b)
Any party shall have the opportunity to cross-examine any witness presented by another
               party.
(c)
Except as to the parties and their respective legal representatives, upon motion of
               either party, the hearing officer may enter an order of sequestration of witnesses.
               In any event, either party may designate one advisory witness who shall not be subject
               to an order of sequestration.
(d)
A witness except a city employee is entitled to fees and mileage provided for a witness
               in the municipal court.
(Code 1981, § 2-142; Ord. No. 3608, §§ 1, 2, 4-3-2003)
